Orientation

The UAE, briefly
Etihad Towers, Abu Dhabi

Where an opportunity sits decides what you can own, how you hold it and who regulates it. The first conversation is usually about this.

Mainland

Onshore companies under federal and emirate law. Most activities now allow full foreign ownership.

Free zones

Jurisdictions with their own regulators and rules. In Abu Dhabi: ADGM on Al Maryah Island for financial and professional services, KEZAD for industry and logistics, Masdar City for clean technology.

Investment zones

Designated areas where non-UAE nationals can hold property freehold, among them Saadiyat, Yas, Al Reem, Al Raha Beach, Al Maryah and Masdar City.

Al Maryah · financial districtSaadiyat · cultureYas · leisureAl Reem · residentialAl Danah · downtown, where K&K is based

Orientation, not advice. Eligibility, structures and fees are confirmed for each case by licensed advisers.

Before you commit

The information checklist, abridged

Every review starts with a checklist built for that opportunity. The answers come from the counterparty and the licensed advisers. The questions come from us, and they look like this.

01

Title & structure

Freehold, leasehold or usufruct, and in whose name. Whether the area is open to non-UAE nationals.

02

Counterparty

Who the developer or sponsor is, what they have delivered before, and on what timeline.

03

Commercial terms

Payment plan, escrow, penalties, handover date, and what is actually included in the price.

04

Holding costs

Service charges, fees, insurance, management and vacancy. The cost of owning, not only of buying.

05

Demand & rent

Who the tenant or buyer is, what comparable units achieve, and how the yield assumption was built.

06

Exit

Resale restrictions, the realistic buyer pool and the time it takes to sell.

Orientation & screening

Your objectives, time horizon, budget and risk appetite, an introduction to the market, and a first commercial read of whatever is being presented.

Commercial assessment

Assumptions, cash requirements, operating costs and scenarios, so the logic is understood before money moves. Formal valuation stays with appointed professionals.

Due-diligence coordination

The checklist, the advisers to answer it and a running view of what remains open, so material issues surface before the decision.

Investor representation

Coordination on your behalf through evaluation, negotiation support, adviser management and implementation.

Post-investment oversight

Leadership

Dr. Tayeb Kamali

Co-Founder & Chairman
Investment and institutional partnerships

Dr. Kamali brings long-standing UAE leadership across education, applied research, government-related institutions, corporate boards and investment networks. His roles have required the assessment of partnerships, institutional opportunities, technology ventures and long-term strategic initiatives involving both public- and private-sector stakeholders.

He chairs the Board of Trustees of the Abu Dhabi School of Management and serves on the boards of Gulf Islamic Investments and Vision Bank. That board and investment experience gives K&K senior-level perspective and relationships across the UAE.

Mohamed Kamali

Managing Director
Investment and hospitality development

An owner and investor by background, Mohamed leads opportunity assessment, investment strategy and commercial structure at K&K. He was Managing Partner of Unity Consulting for a decade, co-founded VUL9 Security Solutions and remains active in venture capital and angel investment.

Through Kohantei in Dubai and now Abu Dhabi, he also brings an operator's eye to any opportunity where a business, not only a building, is being bought.
